column3: Timestamp Disclosure - /healthz expoe time intencional para monitoramento
Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens - mitigado via Content-Type: application/json
Storable and Cacheable Content - assets estaticos sao intencionalmente cacheaveis
X-Content-Type-Options - header presente, falso positivo em respostas sem body
